protocol.description:
This experimental protocol allows a client to create a keyboard group management object for a wl_keyboard and to read or update settings shared by that keyboard group.
Backward incompatible changes may be made while this protocol is unstable.

interface.name: wsm_keyboard_group_manager_v1
interface.description: The manager creates one wsm_keyboard_group_v1 object for a wl_keyboard. Destroying the manager does not destroy objects previously created from it.

request.name: get_keyboard_group

description.summary: manage the group represented by a wl_keyboard

request.description: Create a keyboard group management object for keyboard. After creation, the compositor sends repeat_info and start_num_lock with the current values before processing subsequent changes requested on the object.

entry.name: invalid_keyboard
entry.summary: the wl_keyboard is inert or invalid

interface.name: wsm_keyboard_group_v1
interface.description:
This object exposes the repeat settings and startup Num Lock preference associated with a wl_keyboard's keyboard group.
The compositor sends both state events when this object is initialized. It also sends an event whenever the corresponding value changes.

request.name: set_repeat_info

description.summary: set key repeat rate and delay

request.description: Set the key repeat rate in characters per second and the delay in milliseconds before repeating begins. A rate of zero disables repeat.

arg.name: rate
arg.summary: repeat rate in characters per second

request.name: set_start_num_lock

description.summary: set the startup Num Lock preference

request.description: Set whether Num Lock should be enabled when the keyboard group starts.

arg.name: enabled
arg.summary: 1 to enable Num Lock, 0 to disable it

description.summary: destroy this keyboard group management object

event.name: repeat_info

description.summary: report key repeat rate and delay

event.description: This event is sent when the object is initialized and whenever the key repeat settings change.

arg.name: rate
arg.summary: repeat rate in characters per second

event.name: start_num_lock

description.summary: report the startup Num Lock preference

event.description: This event is sent when the object is initialized and whenever the startup Num Lock preference changes.

arg.name: enabled
arg.summary: 1 when Num Lock starts enabled, otherwise 0

entry.name: invalid_repeat_info
entry.summary: the repeat rate or delay is outside the supported range

entry.name: invalid_num_lock
entry.summary: the Num Lock value is neither zero nor one

entry.name: save_failed
entry.summary: the compositor could not persist the requested value
